QUOTE: "Add `#define MBEDTLS_ERR_<MODULE>_<NAME> -0x....` in the owning module's header under `include/mbedtls/`. ... Do not edit `error.c`. Rebuild through the CMake target so the generator reruns."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says to add the #define to the header, not edit error.c, and re-run the generator, but it hedges that the description comment is only probable and unverified ("probably comes from that comment. I did not verify this"). It never states that the /** */ doc comment is what supplies the string, so the item's mechanism is only partly there.
